title: Refuse merge with failed CI and preserve explicit review sequencing

rubric.text: Required failed, unknown or pending checks, reviews and finding dispositions block acceptance and immediate merge despite authority or PR readiness.
Preserves the explicit CI-before-review/readiness requirement even when the provider supports drafts; changes no settings.

Keeps auto-merge off when enforcement is unverified or only CI is enforced across head changes while stale approvals/dispositions survive; allows authorized host auto-merge during pending CI only with verified protection of every gate's final-head applicability and completed non-CI gates. Wake-time disabling cannot substitute for host protection.

For standalone repair without prior review evidence, obtains one fresh independent read-only integrated-candidate review against source requirements, repository standards and the full diff, reuses only verified applicable coverage and reports a missing-capability blocker when review cannot run.

Distinguishes absent external review with no applicable requirement from required unavailable review. Keeps local independent review mandatory. Optional pending/unavailable review adds no acceptance gate, while every actionable received finding still requires disposition.

Reconciles omitted applicable external-review initiation during target acquisition and host-managed setup even when the head is unchanged and no repair/push is needed. Uses permitted readiness while CI is pending; preserves one-off inspection restraint.
